full_text:
GHOST-FLOW: Where the L.A. Care $55 Million Settlement Actually Went

Headline figure: $55.0M
Joint L.A. Care enforcement settlement announced Oct. 8, 2024

DMHC side: $35.0M

$13.5M monetary penalty
* Paid to DMHC within 30 days
* Enters California's Managed Care Administrative Fines and Penalties Fund (Fund 3133)
* $1M transferred to the Medically Underserved Account in the Health Professions Education Fund
* Remaining applicable balance transferred to Health Care Service Plans Fines and Penalties Fund (Fund 3311)
* NOT direct compensation to members
* NOT unrestricted DMHC operating money

$21.5M community investment
* Los Angeles County benefit only
* Must support approved quality / CalAIM / behavioral health objectives
* L.A. Care proposes projects; DMHC pre-approves
* Must be "separate and distinct" from ordinary or already-required community reinvestment
* Proof of each contribution due within 30 days
* Must be completed within 3 years
* Control model: proposal → approval → disbursement → proof

DHCS side: $20.0M

$13.5M sanction amount
* Documented in the joint settlement structure
* Specific Treasury / fund destination not established by the reviewed public primary materials
* Do not label "General Fund" without the payment-direction record

$6.5M community investment
* Part of the joint $28.0M community-investment total
* Associated with the DHCS side of the settlement
* Detailed public control terms not fully established in the reviewed materials

Bottom-line reconstruction
* $27.0M = cash penalties / sanctions
* $28.0M = community investments
* Total = $55.0M
* Independent monitoring / consultation period: 2 years
* Community-investment spending period: 3 years

Forensic summary based on the L.A. Care-DMHC-DHCS October 2024 settlement architecture. Key distinction: public materials support the amounts and structure, but not every fund trace or control detail is identical across the DMHC and DHCS components.
